name: Uplifter Glassworker GW1125 glazing robot
summary: Uplifter's largest radio-controlled glazing robot: a hydraulic lifter on solid rubber tyres with outriggers and a removable vacuum cross that lifts glass elements of up to 1,125 kg to 4.55 m. Made, sold and rented by Uplifter in Guteneck, Bavaria.

germany.statusNote: Sold and rented by the German maker Uplifter (Guteneck, Bavaria) through purchase and rental request forms; no price shown. The maker states 24 h delivery time and worldwide delivery.

sellers.name: Uplifter Service GmbH
sellers.note: 92543 Guteneck, Germany. Purchase or rental request on the product page; used machines on request.

notes: Maker recommends use only on stable and non-slip surfaces, so roughGround is false.
Optical sensors prevent the machine from falling over floor edges, landings and steps (stairs false).
Quick-change system swaps the vacuum cross for a forklift fork or cable winch without tools; the vacuum cross can also be used separately.
Battery-powered per the product configurator (standard battery or battery extension); runtime not stated.
Remote-controlled by an operator; not autonomous.
